notes: Chunk 134: 25 candidates reviewed from saved text; 2 program-list, 9 single-record, 14 not-a-list. Single records: nine WHU magazine items on individual dissertation defenses, mostly from the Chair of Production Management / supply chain group (Scholz 2020, Doetsch 2023, Nair 2023, Frauen 2023, Kuennen 2023, Bebersdorf prize 2023) plus von Wedel (digital health economics, 2022). Two are German/English pairs of the same item (Nair; Frauen), so count each person once. Placement facts stated: Nair joins MIT Digital Supply Chain Transformation 1 June 2023; Kuennen returned to McKinsey & Company as Senior Associate after the PhD and founded Wing Labs GmbH in 2023; Frauen was at Volkswagen Group at defense and Bebersdorf is Director Manufacturing Tractor at AGCO-Fendt (both look like external/industry doctoral candidates, so the industry role is not a post-degree first job without further evidence). Judgment call: the WMU commons.wmu.se Port Management dissertations listing is marked not-a-list because the entries are WMU MSc in Maritime Affairs specialization dissertations (specialization + nationality format, co-authored entries, no PhD indicated); the page itself does not state the degree level, so an integrator may reclassify if WMU doctoral dissertations are wanted.
